mostWorthwhile.text: Remaking ATP was the most worthwhile construction: the planned two-panel illustration connects electron flow, a hydrogen-ion gradient and ATP production rather than relying on the powerhouse slogan.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen was comparatively brief; the planned pathway distinguishes oxygen's role from fuel's, but leaves the intervening electron-transfer machinery mostly implicit.

surprise.text: The ATP-making plan made the connection between electron flow and hydrogen-ion movement more explicit than I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; each ingredient had a visible connection to the goal, although the choices were fairly predictable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting familiar cell biology to a working ion pump suggests that later constructions could make other physiological relationships concrete.
